result.reason: The redline does not reach either playbook position. Although Sparkling receives affiliate and successor assignment rights, Garman's consent right is not qualified as not unreasonably withheld. Garman is not prohibited from assigning to a Sparkling competitor; the clause merely gives Sparkling a post-assignment termination or licence remedy. Nor does Garman receive the fallback successor-assignment right. Existing subsection (c) also remains and may conflict with Sparkling's new assignment carve-outs. The newly acquired-entity, outsourcer, IT-provider, termination, and licence provisions go beyond what is needed and alter separate use, sublicensing, and remedy rights. Terms such as “competitor” are also undefined, and the treatment of assignment versus transfer of the Software is imprecise.
